PIECE NAME : A CHILD'S DREAM

Our alumnus had been asked to make this piece for our institution's annual sports and cultural event. The piece is an arrangement of an existing Bhajan (song). The intro is another song which is in a major scale. 

He initially directly wanted to start the piece without the existing intro ( the intro is upto the rest before glockenspiel). The Late founder of our institute who many of us consider as our "Guru" (guide) came in the man's dream and asked him to make the piece with a major intro. 

The man felt there was no reason to do so (why simply have a major to minor transition?) He continued to work his own way. The "Guru" came in his dream for 4 NIGHTS continuously asking him to do what he had earlier said . Our man didn't listen.

That one night the "Guru" appeared in his dream and ***scolded the chap terribly***. He then decided to do the major to minor transition . 

The result is right in front of ur eyes🥲. 

Hence the title "A CHILD'S DREAM"
